title: The month potato prices jumped across India
summary: In May 2018, the median potato market moved +28.0% in a month, 2.2 standard deviations from the usual for that month.
why_selected: Chosen automatically: the 2.2σ seasonal move is among the largest on record for potato, across 673 reporting markets.

evidence.observations: monthly medians of daily modal prices; markets need ≥5 reports in both months
caveats: Many market points are district centres, not mandi gates.
Modal prices are reported aggregates, not transaction offers.

scenes.headline: May 2018
scenes.caption: Potato prices across 673 markets that reported in both April 2018 and May 2018.

scenes.headline: Median move +28.0%
scenes.caption: The typical market's potato price jumped 28.0% in one month. 89% of markets moved the same way.

scenes.headline: 2.2× the usual swing
scenes.caption: Compared with the same month in every earlier year on record, this move was 2.2 standard deviations from normal.

scenes.headline: West Bengal
scenes.caption: Neighbouring markets moved together: the 67 reporting markets in West Bengal had a median change of +42.6%.

scenes.headline: Pakur
scenes.caption: Pakur (Jharkhand), one of the busiest markets among the biggest movers: monthly median ₹800 → ₹1,400 per quintal (+75.0%).

scenes.headline: What this does and doesn't show
scenes.caption: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.

conclusion: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.
